title: Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features
abstract: arXiv:2610.02189v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature

translated_title: 通过强化稀疏自编码器特征对内在无序蛋白区域进行生成式建模
translated_abstract: 内在无序蛋白区域在转录调控、信号转导和亚细胞定位等细胞过程中发挥着核心作用，但其功能设计仍然具有挑战性。基于结构的设计方法并不适用于IDRs，而现有的蛋白质语言模型是在全长蛋白序列上训练的，因此学到的先验分布偏向于折叠结构域。在此，我们提出了IDiom，一个自回归蛋白质语言模型，它是在IDiom-DB（一个从AlphaFold数据库中筛选整理得到的、包含5400万个预测IDR的数据集）上训练而成的。IDiom能够生成多样化的序列，重现天然IDRs的氨基酸组成、模式、基序以及预测的无序性。为了控制与功能相关的序列模式，我们还引入了基于稀疏自编码器特征的强化学习，这是一种后训练方法，通过奖励生成能够激活指定特征的序列来引导模型输出。
tldr: 该论文提出了IDiom——一个在5400万条预测无序蛋白区域数据集上训练的自回归蛋白质语言模型，并首创了基于稀疏自编码器特征的强化学习方法，实现了对内在无序蛋白区域功能相关序列模式的可控生成。
en_tdlr: This paper presents IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on a dataset of 54 million predicted intrinsically disordered protein regions, and introduces RL-SAE, a novel reinforcement learning post-training method that leverages sparse autoencoder features to enable controllable generation of function-associated sequence patterns in IDRs.
